---
name: provenance-check
description: Check Ventura System diagrams explanations and pattern references for accurate attribution and license boundaries. Use when adapting upstream system-design material or architecture examples. Do not use when the change is an original repository summary with no external dependency.
---

# Provenance check

- Identify external diagrams articles books repositories or architecture examples used by the change.
- Distinguish general architectural ideas from copied expression or diagrams.
- Read `PROVENANCE.md` when present and keep it aligned.
- Preserve required attribution and license terms for derived assets.
- Prefer original diagrams and wording when copying is unnecessary.
- Remove unsupported affiliation or certification implications.
